method.xref_completion: Each named cell was queried live with `python tools/bsp.py ghidra xrefs <address> --limit 5000`. The two large results contained 577 rows for 00F8D394 and 148 rows for 0108D6DC, with no truncation marker. The smaller results were returned in full. Writer sets below include WRITE and READ_WRITE rows from those complete results, rather than the default capped xref head.
method.listing_evidence: Writer instructions and call sites were checked with live Ghidra instruction-context/bytes queries. Function identity and caller/callee sets were checked through bsp.py lookup/xrefs.
method.pe_evidence: A read-only pefile section check against the installed executable found every investigated cell in the virtual tail of .data. The section has SizeOfRawData 0x10000 and Misc_VirtualSize 0x297edc; each cell's section delta exceeds 0x10000, so there are no corresponding on-disk bytes. Windows loader zero-fill is the original initial state. Live Ghidra byte reads also returned zero for all cells.

smallest_grounded_next_boundary.bounded_scalar_step: A process-lifetime scalar-domain object may own exactly one zero-initialized NativeRendererSynchronizationGlobals record, one shared serial DWORD, one texture counter DWORD, and one surface counter DWORD, and expose references to them. Original evidence supports ordinary loader-zero initialization and no CRT callback for these four cells. It must not claim ownership of 00F8D394 or create GameNativeTextureOwnerServices.
smallest_grounded_next_boundary.production_gate: Production texture-owner composition still requires a canonical real renderer process. That packet must complete or adopt the 0x1D94 00B32410 construction path, use the same primary renderer publication cell, preserve registration of primary+0Ch in the existing singleton manager, route deletion through 00B339F0/00B32920/00B25FE0, and couple StartWorker/StopWorkerMode to the same 8-byte synchronization record. A null, fake, or independently typed renderer owner would not reproduce the observed domain.
smallest_grounded_next_boundary.recommended_next_packet: Keep the first implementation bounded to the four scalar cells and borrowed views, while making renderer publication an explicit unsatisfied input. Separately close the full renderer constructor/deleting-dispatch boundary before instantiating GameNativeTextureOwnerServices in production.
